---
title: "actor_not_found"
description: "No Durable Object namespace was found for an actor type, or the binding is not an actor-kit Durable Object."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** No Durable Object namespace was found for an actor type, or the binding is not an actor-kit Durable Object.

**How to fix it:** Export the actor class from the Worker (ctx.exports) or add a Durable Object binding for it in wrangler.jsonc.

Returned (not thrown) as a refusal: `{ ok: false, code, message, expected?, details?, docs }` from `send()`, `simulate().send` and the WebSocket `__error` frame; thrown by `testActor` as a `RefusalError`.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
